utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m finalizing the timing and sorting plan this afternoon, Dane, and I’ll share the schedule as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli—sorry I’m late. Once you share the schedule, I’ll help spread the word and jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works, Dane—I’ll send you the schedule once I’ve got the drop-off times and sorting table plan set, and then we can divide up the jobs cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If it’s still 10, that should work for me—I just need to keep school pickup clear later.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m tracking Saturday at 10 by the community shed too, so that should line up fine.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—if anything shifts from 10, just let me know so I can keep school pickup sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 10 by the community shed—bring any basic tools you’ve got, and I’ll plug you in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll be there with my tools, and Sam’s set to help on the wobbly chairs and that busted lamp.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—see you Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and we’ll start with the chairs and lamp.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m there Saturday at 10 with my tools, and once the workspace is ready I’ll start on the chairs and then check the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’s a big help. Just a quick update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so can you still make it then with your tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can make Sunday at the community center with my tools, and once the workspace is ready I’ll start on the chairs and then check the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, before we lock anything down, can you confirm whether Cleo has actually set the day yet, or are we still just leaning Saturday while the start time gets checked?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t heard Cleo confirm it outright, so I’d still treat Saturday as tentative while the start time gets checked.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps; then let’s keep Saturday tentative for now and not lock the volunteers or fix list until Cleo confirms the day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—that setup’s going to help a lot, and I’ll keep sending folks from Cedar and Pine over to Mara’s table this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—I'll keep the kit, screws, and patch supplies organized here at Mara’s table for whoever comes by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—that’ll keep things moving, and I’ll keep spreading the word on Cedar and Pine so more neighbors bring their lamps and radios by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, did anyone lock the date yet, and can we get the repair list written out with who’s covering each job?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not that I’ve heard, and I really don’t want us planning around it until the date is locked and the repair list is written out with names on each job.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then who’s confirming the date today, and who’s writing the job list with names so we can stop guessing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update on the repair-drive plan or final timing yet? I’m still waiting on the full repair list too, so send both when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we sure it’s actually happening yet, and can we confirm the date and who’s bringing the tools before we rely on it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: From what I’ve got, it’s still on for late morning and Gus is bringing the tools, but I’m waiting on the full repair list and final timing too—send me any firm update and I’ll check it between stops.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Jules, the repair drive’s this Saturday afternoon, and I’ve been telling everyone so we get a good turnout. If you can, help spread the word so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—I’m happy to help spread the word, but we’re still checking with a couple more people before we lock the day in, and Saturday just seems to be leading so far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Jules—Saturday afternoon’s still the leading plan, and I’ll keep telling folks that while we wait to lock it in so we get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Cleo’s leading it, and I still need to double-check the exact start time, but I can sort the screws and patch supplies in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d help a lot, Oren—the repair drive’s really picking up, and folks on Maple have already dropped off a good stack of tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, just point me to the screws and patch supplies, and I’ll get them sorted while I check with Cleo about the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Saturday at 10 by the community shed is set, so I’ll start lining up volunteers next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay... I only have Sam on bike repairs, Lila bringing tools, and Cleo keeping the basic kit, screws, and patch supplies at your table so far.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s a solid start—thanks, Rey. I’ll build from Sam, Lila, and Cleo and keep pulling in a few more volunteers for Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Nell, I’ve got the repair drive pinned to the community center lot this afternoon, and I’m confirming the exact start time next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’d only heard from Vik that it was happening, so Rosa is still the one I’d trust on the start time and who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That matches what I’ve got too—it’s at the community center lot this afternoon, and I’ll check with Rosa to confirm the exact start time.
